cases.title: Placement role denial
cases.steps: Sign in as Student and request the company-create page.
cases.expected: HTTP 403.

cases.title: Publication reminder
cases.steps: Publish a draft round containing a required checklist item.
cases.expected: Published state and a reminder record exactly 24 hours before closing.

cases.title: Checklist toggle
cases.steps: Toggle an open round item twice as the same Student.
cases.expected: First request adds completion, second removes it. This is a toggle, not HTTP retry idempotency.

cases.title: Penalty-to-grade workflow
cases.steps: Upload late under a 20 percent penalty, then grade as the assignment owner.
cases.expected: One accepted submission with penalty 20 and a stored grade of 82/100.

cases.title: Rejected upload persistence
cases.steps: Upload after a reject-policy deadline.
cases.expected: Redirect with rejection feedback and no Submission row.

cases.title: Student file privacy
cases.steps: Request another student's uploaded file.
cases.expected: HTTP 403 without file disclosure.

cases.expected: Dashboard loads and its activity context excludes the TA event.

cases.title: TA roster ownership
cases.steps: Open another TA's assignment and list assignments as the unrelated TA.
cases.expected: Detail returns 403, and the list excludes the other TA's assignment.

cases.expected: Form reports a file error and creates no submission.

cases.title: Login, logout and CSRF
cases.steps: Try anonymous dashboard access, login without CSRF, invalid credentials, valid CSRF login and POST logout.
cases.expected: Anonymous access redirects, missing CSRF returns 403, bad credentials stay on the form, valid login reaches dashboard and logout ends access.

cases.title: Publication precondition and repeat
cases.steps: Publish without an item, add a required item, then publish twice.
cases.expected: First attempt remains draft without reminder. Later attempts leave exactly one matching reminder.

cases.title: Duplicate, grade validation and persistence
cases.steps: Upload twice, submit a score above the maximum, then review and grade correctly. Try reviewing the graded record and download as the student.
cases.expected: Original file remains the only submission. Invalid score creates no grade. Final state stays graded and the student sees feedback and original bytes.

cases.title: Repeatable demo startup
cases.steps: Run the synthetic demo seed command twice.
cases.expected: Exactly three users, one company, one round, three checklist items, one assignment and one updated reminder. Existing reminder identity is preserved.

cases.title: Exact deadline
cases.steps: Evaluate an upload at the exact due timestamp.
cases.expected: Accepted on time with no penalty.

cases.title: One second late
cases.steps: Apply reject policy one second after the due timestamp.
cases.expected: Rejected, with no accepted late status.

cases.title: Configured penalty
cases.steps: Apply penalty policy to a late timestamp with a 15 percent penalty.
cases.expected: Accepted with penalty status and the configured 15 percent.

cases.title: Grace boundary
cases.steps: Submit exactly 30 minutes after the due time with 30 minutes of grace.
cases.expected: Accepted in the grace window.

cases.title: After grace
cases.steps: Submit one second after the configured grace boundary.
cases.expected: Rejected.

cases.title: Unsupported late policy
cases.steps: Evaluate a late timestamp using an unknown policy name.
cases.expected: ValueError prevents silently accepting an unsupported late policy.
